name: Infinity Stone increases spell critical strike chance (#3903)
contract: Infinity Stone 300873 is a raid-wide passive: effect 0 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID, SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT/290, EffectBasePoints 2 -> 3%) and effect 1 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE/350, self-targeted, EffectBasePoints 2 -> 3%). Player::UpdateSpellCritChance sums SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT into the cached per-school crit percentage (StatSystem.cpp); Unit::SpellCritChanceDone separately adds SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE by school mask at cast time. This scenario proves the raid-aura component (290) moves the cached stat that both the client tooltip and spell_crit_chance read; the personal component (350) is verified by code trace since no scenario metric reads Unit::SpellCritChanceDone's total directly.
